notes: Moving several photos together, including ones across the fold, keeps them all selected and is one step in Undo
Flipping or turning a photo across the fold keeps both halves, and applying a photo edit can be undone with Command Z
Redesigning a story leaves locked pages exactly where they are, and a photo dropped on a locked page goes on top
Exporting spreads as pictures from a right-to-left album now pairs the pages the way Design shows them
Space plays and pauses a guide video, and the Start here video is described as about 90 seconds
